title: Visit each item
prompt: Implement `public static void Visit(List<string> items, Action<string> emit)`. Call `emit` once per item in order. An empty list makes no calls.
hints: Action has no return value. What should happen to each item?
Use one loop and pass each item to emit.
Call `emit(item)` exactly once inside the loop. Do not call it after or before the loop.
checkLabels: The action must receive every item once in order.
An empty list must make no calls.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Visits items from last to first.
Starts at index one and misses the first item.

feedback: Use a loop that starts at the first item and call the action exactly once in each loop run.
